headline: Analog Devices authors compare FPGA fixed-point modeling with an earlier SVREAL-generated implementation
fact: Analog Devices CSS authors published an industrial case study of a synthesizable fixed-point SystemVerilog model for a Voice Coil Motor driver, derived from analog equations and deployed on FPGA for real-time emulation. The paper compares the implementation with an earlier automated real-number RTL generation flow using the SVREAL library, reports reduced FPGA resource use for the manual fixed-point implementation, and validates model fidelity against the reference analog behavioral model.

sources.title: Synthesizable Fixed-Point Model of a Voice Coil Motor Driver for FPGA Emulation
sources.summary: The September 6, 2026 Chips paper by Analog Devices CSS authors presents the VCM FPGA-emulation case, compares manual fixed-point RTL with an earlier MSDSL/SVREAL implementation, and reports FPGA resource and model-fidelity results.
